prompt: An attacker sends an urgent text message pretending to be the CEO of a company, requesting the immediate purchase of gift cards for an offsite client meeting. Which combination of social engineering attack vector and psychological lever is being exploited?
rationale: Smishing is phishing delivered via SMS/text message. Posing as the CEO exploits human obedience to authority figures.

prompt: Which physical security control is specifically designed to eliminate the risk of tailgating by utilizing two interlocking doors where only one door can be opened at a time?
rationale: A security vestibule (mantrap) enforces single-person entry through interlocking doors, preventing tailgating.

prompt: A packet filtering firewall processes rules in sequential top-to-bottom order. Rule 1 allows all traffic from any source to port 80. Rule 2 blocks traffic from IP 198.51.100.5 to port 80. What action will the firewall take when IP 198.51.100.5 sends a packet to port 80?

options.A: The packet is denied because specific rules override general rules.
options.B: The packet is allowed because Rule 1 matches first and remaining rules are ignored.
options.C: The packet is quarantined until administrative approval.
options.D: The packet is dropped by the implicit deny rule.

rationale: Firewalls operate on a first-match-wins principle. Because Rule 1 permits all traffic to port 80, Rule 2 is never evaluated.

prompt: Which security principle is violated when all employees in an accounting firm are assigned permanent Local Administrator accounts on their office workstations?
rationale: The Principle of Least Privilege states that accounts should only possess the minimum privileges necessary to perform daily job functions.

prompt: A web application vulnerability allows an attacker to input raw JavaScript code into a public comment section, which then executes in the browser of any user who views the page. Which vulnerability is this?
rationale: Stored XSS occurs when malicious scripts are permanently stored on the target server and executed in other users' browsers upon viewing.
